references.text: Gideon sent messengers throughout Manasseh, Asher, Zebulun, and Naphtali to gather them for battle against the Midianites, the same tribes that were now being called together for pursuit.
Gideon also sent messengers to Ephraim asking for their help in pursuing the Midianites, as a continuation of the mobilization described here.
The pursuit of the Midianites continued across the Jordan, where Gideon and his men were exhausted but still pressed on after the enemy.
Description of the tribes Naphtali, Asher, and Manasseh and their territories, the same tribes that were called together to pursue the Midianites.
A similar pattern where Israelites gathered to pursue the Philistines after an initial victory, just as the tribes gathered against the Midianites.
The psalm mentions Gideon's victory over Midian as an example of God's powerful intervention against Israel's enemies.
